title: Produced-dataset index (cached.toml) — spec-v3
description: JSON Schema for the JSON projection of a cached.toml produced-dataset index. Parse the TOML to JSON, then validate. spec-v3 adds the optional recipe `version` (entry) and optional declared `project` id (_META).

project.description: Optional declared project id (default cached scope; else derived).

entry.description: A produced dataset, addressed by portable key (cachetype + optional version + hash), never by absolute path.

version.description: Optional recipe/code version (a path segment when set).

hash.description: Lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of the canonical-JSON key table.
